claim: Edge-additive transfer risks give a certified phase-pair pruning scheduler; the equal-cost scheduler is cardinality-optimal under the scalar additive certificate.
non_claims: The exact-envelope greedy refinement is not claimed globally optimal.
The unequal-cost greedy schedule is not claimed integer-knapsack optimal.
The double-buffer model assumes ideal asynchronous overlap and does not constitute a GPU benchmark.
The large synthetic experiment is not evidence for a universal optimal pruning pattern on genotype data.
